title: Raven Character Loader — presence engine + universal adapter → runnable embodiment stack
objective: Build a character loader that loads a persona (Raven, and later Voss/Tappy) into a body. It must: (1) load a character's SOUL + presence engine (affect -> action units); (2) bind it to the universal adapter HAL (adapters/base.py + unitree/blender/digital_world/elf); (3) run the body driver loop. Inputs already exist at characters/myl1ssa/Myl1Ssa/ (presence_engine.py, adapters/, brain/). Deliver a single runnable entry point that says 'load Raven' and wires presence -> adapter -> body end-to-end, verified via the null/socket transport (no hardware required).
